mission: Strengthen stroke L1/L2 classification with the enlarged stroke taxonomy labels (wave-d d13 + wave-c c18); evaluate L1/L2 accuracy, unknown/ambiguous handling, and confidently-wrong rate grouped by session.

datasetScope.goldFile: datasets/paddle-bench/stroke-gold.json (29 labels, wave-c c18 + wave-d d13, append-only, untouched)

unevaluable.reason: no committed pose for these cases on Linux; canonical runs/ require macOS Apple Vision extraction (BLOCKED_EXTERNAL for those 11 labels — not fabricated)

datasetScope.heldOut: wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 were never viewed, labeled, evaluated, or tuned against (also absent from stroke-gold by construction)
datasetScope.grouping: by corpus sessionKey (dvids-marne-2024, afn-sasebo-2025-06, dvids-warriorgames-2026) and by event owner (target/other) — never random-frame splits

configuration.benchmark: packages/swing-lab/src/strokeHeuristicBench.ts (stroke-heuristic-bench-v1, new; CLI: pnpm --filter @pickle/swing-lab exec tsx src/strokeHeuristicBench.ts)
configuration.paddle: null everywhere — no committed paddle track for these windows; all contact points wrist-derived
configuration.reference: gold contactMs when present; measured in-window dominant-wrist speed peak when contactMs is null (never a window midpoint)
configuration.l1Definition: OVERHEAD vs SWING — the class the heuristic can claim without bounce observation; families inside SWING are not separable by design
configuration.confidentlyWrongDefinition: committed (non-UNKNOWN) prediction wrong at L1 or L2

changes.description: Non-swing speed gate fires only with >=3 measured samples inside the event window; a window slice with zero samples of an otherwise long series was firing 'no_swing_energy_in_window' from absence of measurement (contract violation).
changes.motivatingFailure: wavea-faead-rally @13875 (gold volley/forehand): 0 in-window speed samples -> false non-stroke abstention

changes.description: Reference-frame torso extent < 0.6x the sequence's own median torso extent abstains (transient hip-line collapse passes the absolute 0.04 floor but yields garbage normalization). Dev anchors: collapsed frame 41% of median (wrong commit), smallest legitimate reference 65%.
changes.motivatingFailure: wavea-944403-dink @22000 (gold overhead_lob): torso 0.057u vs median 0.140u -> confidently-wrong BACKHAND

changes.description: Dominant-wrist attribution abstains when the rival wrist has zero measured frames within ±200ms of the reference — its zero travel is absence, not stillness, so 'this wrist moved more' is unverifiable.
changes.motivatingFailure: wavea-marne-dig @14042 (gold overhead_lob/overhead): striking arm never measured; the visible non-striking wrist was committed as FOREHAND at conf 0.8

delta.l1Correct: 8 -> 9 (faead-rally @13875 recovered from a false non-stroke abstention)
delta.notLost: no previously-correct row regressed; the two fixed confidently-wrong rows became honest abstentions with recorded reasons

unknownAmbiguousHandling.note: gold-unknown labels are first-class outcomes (never scored correct/wrong); prediction abstentions are counted separately from wrong; OTHER-owned rows carry per-row attribution-risk disclosures and are a separate slice

remainingFailures.rootCause: near-side-on view: shoulder x-separation 0.042u vs torso 0.114u makes the shoulder-order facing sign a coin flip; correct rows exist at even lower shoulder/torso ratios (serve 0.29, smash 0.24), so a ratio gate would destroy correct calls — no generalizable fix found in this data

contact measured 1.70 shoulder-widths on the player's right in a front view; a cross-body backhand (or unrecorded left-handedness) breaks the midline-side proxy — unresolvable without more measured evidence

remainingFailures.row: wavea-faead-rally @13875 (gold volley/forehand -> BACKHAND, exposed by the v4 speed-gate fix)
remainingFailures.rootCause: dominant-wrist choice fell to the LEFT wrist (travel 0.07 vs right 0.02) with the rival sparsely measured (4 frames); raising the rival-measurement floor above 0 would also abstain a correct row (sasebo @52434, rival 1 frame) — declined as bench-fitting

validation.tests: packages/swing-lab: 477 passed / 4 skipped (includes new test/strokeHeuristicV4Gates.test.ts, 7 tests, and test/strokeHeuristicBench.test.ts, 11 tests); full root pnpm test green
validation.gates: pnpm format:check, pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint, pnpm test all pass at codeCommit

blockedExternal: 11/29 gold labels (afn-sasebo-rally1/2, wm-volley-02) are not evaluable on Linux: canonical run dirs require macOS Apple Vision pose extraction
No committed paddle tracks for the wave-a windows: production paddle-informed contact points could not be exercised
verdictRationale: First prediction-side L1/L2 numbers ever measured for classifyStroke (18/29 gold labels, session-grouped). Three generalizable absence-of-measurement gates (versioned as stroke-heuristic-4) measurably reduced L1 wrong 2->0 and confidently-wrong 4->3 without losing any correct row; remaining failures are root-caused and disclosed rather than tuned away.
